faq.a1: If your Mac has Apple silicon and macOS 13 Ventura or later, yes. It won't run on Intel Macs. To check, choose About This Mac from the Apple menu. If it lists a chip like Apple M1 or newer, you're set.
faq.a10: It's on the page you see right after paying, and always in your customer portal. Sign in there with the email you paid with. If you bought from inside the app, you don't need it: Outbound unlocks by itself.
faq.a11: Yes, on up to three at once with one key. Moving to a new Mac? Click Deactivate in Outbound's Settings on the old one, or use your customer portal, then paste your key on the new one.
faq.a12: Pick a place that matters to you, and I'll paint it into Outbound. After you buy, I'll email you to agree on the place, and it's usually ready about a week later. Outbound itself is included.
faq.a13: No. The app has no account, no analytics and no tracking, and it never asks to see your screen or your files. The bird knows where your cursor is, but that stays on your Mac. The privacy policy has the details.
faq.a14: You're welcome to read it, learn from it and send fixes. Using it as your wallpaper needs a license, even if you build it yourself.
faq.a15: Email outbound@edbn.me and you'll hear back from me, the person who made Outbound. The Support page also covers lost keys, moving to a new Mac and more.
faq.a2: It's made to be light, and it stops drawing when nobody can see it: when windows cover the desktop, after five minutes away, and while the screen sleeps. On battery it slows down, or holds a still painting if you'd rather. It also holds still in Low Power Mode, and when your Mac runs hot.
faq.a3: No. Your Mac paints it as it flies over real fields, rivers and towns, so the view keeps changing and never repeats.
faq.a4: Yes. Click the seagull in your menu bar and choose Fly To. You can also set how long it stays over each place, from six minutes to an hour, or keep it over one place for good.
faq.a5: Only if you want it to. It stays in daytime until you change Light in the menu bar. Choose Follows your clock, and evenings turn warm, then windows and street lamps light up after dark.
faq.a6: Yes. One landscape stretches across all of them, laid out the way your displays are, so the view carries on from one screen to the next.
faq.a7: Nothing is lost. Quit Outbound and your own picture comes back on every desktop. While it runs, your lock screen shows a still of the painting. You can turn that off in Settings.
faq.a8: No. You pay once and it's yours, with every update free. Updates install by themselves.
faq.a9: Email me at outbound@edbn.me within 14 days and I'll refund you in full, whether it won't run on your Mac or just isn't what you expected.

support.bug1: Email it, or open an issue on GitHub. Say which Mac and macOS you have.
support.lede: Email outbound@edbn.me. You'll hear back from the person who made Outbound.
support.lost1: It's in your customer portal. Sign in with the email you paid with.
support.lost2: If you bought it in this browser, it's also on the homepage.
support.mac1: One key works on 3 Macs at once.
support.mac2: To free one up, click Deactivate in Outbound's Settings, or use your customer portal.
support.mac3: On the new Mac, choose Unlock Outbound in the menu bar and paste your key.
support.metaDescription: Help with Outbound, the live wallpaper for Mac: your key, moving to a new Mac, and anything else. Email outbound@edbn.me.
support.remove1: Choose Quit Outbound in the menu bar. Your own wallpaper comes back.
support.remove2: Then drag Outbound from Applications to the Trash.
support.still1: It pauses when the screen sleeps or Low Power Mode is on, or while the desktop is hidden if Pause When Hidden is on.
support.still2: It holds still after five minutes away, and wakes when you move the mouse.
support.still3: Paused it yourself? Choose Resume in the menu bar.
support.store1: Updates come through the App Store.
support.store2: On another Mac, get Outbound from the App Store with the same Apple Account.
